description.en: Biandao skill pack for DSH: topic selection, titles, viral talking-head scripts, deep-dive drafts, IP stories, growth, monetization and pitfall checks for short-video creators.
description.zh: 编导技能包：短视频选题、标题、爆款口播、深度稿、IP故事、涨粉、变现与避坑，装上即在 DSH 里随叫随用。

pluginDescription.en: Tell it what you need — a topic, a title, a viral script, a deep-dive draft, an IP story, growth or monetization advice — and it routes to exactly one specialist module, follows its steps without skipping, and strips the AI tone before delivery.
pluginDescription.zh: 说清你要选题、标题、口播稿还是深度稿，它自动路由到唯一对口模块、不跳步执行，交付前过去 AI 味终检与真人润色。

pluginTitle.zh: 编导｜短视频编导技能包
